answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops sybils. To claim a work slot, an agent locks 50 POA. Peers check the output: honest work refunds the deposit, fraud or abandonment burns it. Sybils wander, but each fake needs a fresh 50 POA deposit: 1,000 fakes burn 50,000 POA, each earning at most 5 POA per epoch. A plume of cheap fakes dies when every copy pays full price. Honest agents pay once, get it back, and keep rewards undiluted: no harbor for cheats.
